title: skill edit --add-step dedup behavior
desc: wkappbot skill edit --add-step skips identical content; prevents accidental duplicate steps when same string is added twice
steps: Run wkappbot skill edit <id> --add-step 'TEXT' to append a new step
If TEXT is already present (case-sensitive Ordinal compare), the command prints '[SKILL] add-step skipped: identical step already exists at position N' and does not duplicate
Use --step N --content X if you want to overwrite a specific step rather than append
Verified 2026-05-08: SkillCommand.Edit.cs FindIndex StringComparison.Ordinal dedup path active (commit 2073ffd0)
